rows.title: Extension feels slow
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. Could you share the approximate size of the affected file, the steps that reliably trigger the lag, and your Note Stats and VS Code versions? Please also say which OS and environment you are using (desktop or vscode.dev), and whether the lag remains after disabling all other installed extensions and enabling only Note Stats. That will help determine whether the full-document count performed after each edit is responsible.

Command to copy the current stats to the clipboard
Add a line and paragraph count
Make Note Stats work on vscode.dev as a web extension
Status bar item does not hide when the last editor is closed
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the detailed report. I traced this flow on current `main`: closing the last editor causes `onDidChangeActiveTextEditor` to call `refresh()`, where the missing active editor immediately hides the item. The document-change listener also cannot re-show it afterward because it only refreshes when its document is still the active editor. I can't reproduce the reported state from the current code path, so I'm closing this as not reproducible. If it happens again, a short screen recording together with the Note Stats and VS Code versions would help identify an event sequence or environment difference.

rows.title: Word count counts numbers as words
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. This is the documented counting behavior: Note Stats treats each whitespace-separated token as a word, including numbers, dates, and standalone punctuation, so `3 apples and 2 pears` intentionally reports five words. This keeps the count simple and consistent with the `wc -w` model described in the README. Closing as designed.

rows.title: Add spell checking to Note Stats
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the suggestion. Spell checking and correction suggestions are outside Note Stats' documented scope: https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/blob/main/vision.md keeps the extension focused on measuring text and small, explicitly invoked markdown helpers, while spell checking is owned by other extensions. Closing this as out of scope.

rows.title: Is there a keyboard shortcut for Insert Timestamp?
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the question. Note Stats does not provide a default keybinding for this command. To add your own, open **Preferences: Open Keyboard Shortcuts**, search for **Note Stats: Insert Timestamp**, select the pencil icon next to it, and enter your preferred shortcut. The command ID is `noteStats.insertTimestamp` if you prefer to configure `keybindings.json` directly.

rows.title: Doesn't work
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. Could you clarify what you expected to appear and what you tried—for example, whether you had a text file open and whether the `Note Stats: Toggle Status Bar Item` command or either of the other Note Stats commands appeared in the Command Palette? Please also share the Note Stats version, VS Code version, OS, and whether this is desktop or vscode.dev. If possible, let us know whether the same behavior occurs with other extensions disabled and only Note Stats enabled.

rows.title: Word count is wrong when words are separated by more than one space
Changing noteStats.showCharacters has no effect until the window is reloaded
Character count setting not applied
rows.proposedComment: Thanks for the report. This is the same defect tracked in https://github.com/egamma/sweeper-sandbox/issues/4: `noteStats.showCharacters` is read only when the extension activates, so changing it does not update the status bar until VS Code reloads or restarts. Closing this issue in favor of the older, more detailed report; your confirmation that a restart makes the character count appear is useful supporting evidence.
rows.verifyEvidence: Both report the showCharacters setting having no effect until VS Code is reloaded, the same defect: the setting is read once at activation and never re-read on change.
